claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Sinners won four Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners received 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners set a new record with 16 total nominations, according to The Hollywood Reporter.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
The Hollywood Reporter and The Guardian note that Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first woman and first Black woman to win the Best Cinematography Oscar in the award's 98-year history.
Sinners lost Best Picture to One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
